status: DRAFT for the W2 meeting. All breakpoints are placeholders, to be tuned on the validation split only (DERM-27, Ground rule 3). Design rationale: docs/fuzzy-design.md.

age.missing: unknown: membership 0 in every term, so no rule using age fires

site.missing: unknown: membership 0 in every group, so no rule using site fires

rules.text: IF the image failed validation or the out-of-distribution check THEN cannot assess
rules.explanation: This image could not be assessed reliably. Refer for specialist review.
rules.source: Proposal Section 3 (out-of-distribution check; Lee et al., 2018); objective O3

rules.text: IF melanoma is high THEN urgent
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.2 (refer on a suspected cancer pathway if dermoscopy suggests melanoma)

rules.text: IF melanoma is medium THEN routine
rules.explanation: Some melanoma evidence: specialist review recommended.
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.2 applied to borderline evidence; escalated by F3. Tuning knob for objective O2

rules.text: IF malignancy is high AND melanoma is low THEN routine
rules.explanation: Strong evidence of a non-melanoma skin cancer (such as basal cell carcinoma): non-urgent referral.
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.5 (BCC: non-urgent referral) and 1.7.4 (SCC)

rules.text: IF malignancy is medium AND melanoma is low THEN routine
rules.explanation: Some evidence of a non-melanoma skin cancer: non-urgent referral.
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.5 (a lesion that raises the suspicion of BCC is referred)

rules.text: IF malignancy is low THEN monitor
rules.explanation: Little evidence of skin cancer: GP follow-up.

rules.text: IF uncertainty is high THEN urgency is at least routine
rules.explanation: The model is unsure about this image, so it is not left to GP follow-up.
rules.source: Proposal Section 3; Tschandl et al. (2020): unreliable AI advice misleads clinicians

rules.text: IF melanoma is high THEN urgency is at least urgent
rules.explanation: Strong melanoma evidence is always urgent, whatever the other factors.
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.2; objective O2 (at least 85% of melanomas urgent)

rules.text: IF melanoma is medium AND age is older THEN urgency is at least urgent
rules.explanation: Some melanoma evidence in an older patient: suspected-cancer referral.
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.2; age as a risk factor (HAM10000 EDA: median age melanoma 60 vs nevus 45, to confirm on the train split)

rules.text: IF malignancy is high AND site is head or neck THEN urgency is at least urgent
rules.explanation: Likely skin cancer on the head or neck, where a delay can matter more: suspected-cancer referral.
rules.source: NICE NG12 rec. 1.7.6 (BCC: suspected cancer pathway if delay may have a significant impact, e.g. lesion site)
